node.title: Re^3: Dark Mode for AM?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Dark mode is, for me, more eyestrain and gives me a headache.

Yes, this is true for some people, my rough understading is that as it causes pupils to dilate more, this can cause vision to blur more.

The question here is: Is there a standard (RFC, W3C, ...?)

See my [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/prefers-color-scheme|link] in the root node: It's part of the [https://drafts.csswg.org/mediaqueries-5/#prefers-color-scheme|Media Queries Level 5] W3C draft spec and has been supported by all major browsers for the past ~3-4 years.
